sloka: अधिगंता असि वैदेहीम् अचिरेण इति मे मतिः ।प्रति लभ्य च काकुत्स्थ पितॄ पैतामहम् महीम् ॥३-६९-४०॥
transliteration: adhigaṁtā asi vaidehīm acireṇa iti me matiḥ ।prati labhya ca kākutstha pitṝ paitāmaham mahīm ॥3-69-40॥

translations.english: O scion of the Kakutstha dynasty, on getting the hereditary kingdom and ruling over it you should always remember me.
